subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw add non-USD currency semantics for configured model costs, and if so should currency live per model, per provider, globally, or only as a display preference?
rationale: The request adds a high-bar config surface and affects stored/session cost names, aggregate UI, status output, docs, and USD telemetry, so automation cannot safely choose the product/accounting contract.

options.title: Define contract first
options.body: Choose the currency scope and accounting/display semantics before implementation so every cost surface remains consistent.

options.title: Keep USD-only costs
options.body: Leave configured model costs as USD-only and treat non-USD provider prices as unsupported until maintainers see a stronger product case.

options.title: Add display-only symbol
options.body: Implement a narrow symbol formatter while explicitly accepting that stored values and telemetry remain USD-like estimates.

recommendation.title: Define contract first
recommendation.body: Choose the currency scope and accounting/display semantics before implementation so every cost surface remains consistent.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cost/pricing history makes this the best available routing candidate for the currency/accounting product decision.
